about_the_game:
FROM ALGORITHM TO AGI

Your journey begins with a humble "Initial Algorithm." By clicking and generating revenue, you'll invest in new and more powerful AI technologies. Progress from simple Data Scraping Bots to complex Neural Networks, Large Language Models, and ultimately, the world-changing Artificial General Intelligence. Each of the 10 core generators has a unique role in your expanding empire.

AUTOMATE AND OPTIMIZE

An empire doesn't run on clicks alone. Hire managers to automate your generators and keep the revenue flowing, even when you're offline. Level up your managers to unlock powerful production boosts. Dive into the R&D lab to research game-changing global upgrades, from Cloud Computing to Quantum Computing, that will fundamentally enhance your entire operation.

DEEP STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY

AI Empire is more than just watching numbers go up. It's about making smart decisions.

  • Synergies: Discover and leverage over 20 powerful synergies between your generators. Create a well-oiled machine where every component boosts the others.

  • Prestige System (Go Public): Hit a wall? Take your company public! Reset your progress to earn "Angel Investors" and "IP" (IPO Points), providing massive permanent boosts to your future runs.

  • Company Specializations: After your first prestige, choose a specialization like Machine Learning, Robotics, or Data Analytics for unique bonuses and gameplay styles.

  • IPO Perks: Spend your hard-earned IP on a permanent skill tree that grants powerful advantages like lower costs, faster research, and automated head starts.

A DYNAMIC MARKETPLACE

The world of tech is ever-changing. You'll need to adapt to survive and thrive.

  • Market Events: Unexpected events like a "Data Boom" or a "Server Outage" can provide massive opportunities or temporary challenges.

  • Bounties: Complete active goals and bounties to earn valuable Research Tokens, which can be used to speed up your progress.

  • Competitors: You're not alone in the race for AI dominance. Out-earn rival AI companies to unlock exclusive, permanent bonuses.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR EMPIRE

Who says a tech company has to be boring? Unlock and choose from over 50+ cosmetic themes to give your game a completely new look and feel. Whether you prefer a sleek "Hacker Green" terminal, a groovy "Synthwave" vibe, a "Comic Book" art style, or the opulent "Golden Age" luxury, you can customize your interface to match your mood. New themes are available through gameplay, seasonal events, and DLC packs.

Features:

  • 10 Core AI Generators to build and level up.

  • Deep prestige system with Angel Investors and IPO Perks.

  • Over 20+ strategic synergies to discover.

  • Researchable global upgrades.

  • Managers to automate your workflow.

  • Dynamic Market Events, Bounties, and Competitors.

  • Over 100 achievements to unlock.

  • 50+ unlockable themes for complete visual customization.

Are you ready to build your legacy? Start your AI Empire today and click your way to becoming a tech legend!
